doc.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Playing with Joe Williams in Florida
summary: He played a couple of times with Joe Williams at a Florida club and says Joe can swing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Have you ever had occasion to play much with Joe Williams?
We played a couple of times together at a club in Florida. Oh we had a ball. Joe can swing. Yeah I did a couple of things with Joe.
